Professional Experience / Work History  
As a Data Engineering Consultant at DataFlow Consulting, I’ve focused on architecting scalable data infrastructures for enterprise clients. This involved designing cloud-native data warehouses using Snowflake, which enabled clients to process terabytes of data with sub-second query latency. I also led the migration of legacy ETL processes to Apache Airflow, reducing pipeline downtime by 40% and improving job reliability. My work with Databricks allowed me to optimize complex data transformations, reducing compute costs by 25% through dynamic resource allocation.  

In my earlier role as a Junior Data Engineer at CloudScale Inc., I built ETL pipelines for SaaS platforms using Apache Spark, which improved data ingestion speed by 30%. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to refine database schemas, resulting in a 20% reduction in query execution times. My use of Terraform streamlined infrastructure provisioning, enabling rapid scaling during peak usage periods.  

During my internship at TechNova Solutions, I contributed to data visualization projects by developing dashboards that integrated with client databases. This experience solidified my ability to translate raw data into actionable insights, a skill I’ve continued to refine in subsequent roles.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Apache Airflow: Engineered end-to-end data pipelines for clients, ensuring fault tolerance and real-time monitoring.  
Data Warehousing: Spearheaded the design of Snowflake-based warehouses, optimizing query performance through partitioning and indexing strategies.  
ETL Pipeline Design: Automated data workflows using Apache Spark and dbt, reducing manual intervention in data preparation.  
Snowflake: Implemented secure, scalable data lakes for clients, leveraging its multi-cloud capabilities to meet compliance requirements.  
Docker: Containerized data processing jobs to ensure consistency across development and production environments.  
Terraform: Provisioned cloud resources for data platforms, enabling teams to deploy infrastructure with version-controlled configurations.  
dbt: Built data transformation models that improved data accuracy and reduced reconciliation time by 15%.  
Python: Scripted custom data validation routines and integrated with third-party APIs to enrich datasets.  
REST API Design: Developed lightweight endpoints to expose data assets, facilitating seamless integration with client applications.  
CI/CD Pipelines: Integrated code changes into production environments using GitOps practices, minimizing deployment risks.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Led a data warehouse migration project for a healthcare client, transitioning from traditional SQL databases to Snowflake. This involved designing a schema that supported complex analytics while maintaining data integrity. The solution reduced query latency by 50% and enabled real-time reporting for clinical teams.  

Developed a custom ETL framework using Apache Spark and Airflow, which processed 10+ million records daily. The system was deployed across three regions, ensuring low-latency data availability for global users.
